## spe/evals/harness/grader.js (changed part)

```js
const PRIORITIES = ["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"]

function normPriority(v) {
  if (typeof v !== "string") return null
  const s = v.trim().toUpperCase()
  return PRIORITIES.includes(s) ? s : null
}

function priorityCorrect(output, reference) {
  const got = normPriority(output)
  return got !== null && got === normPriority(reference)
}

// selftest additions
const PRIORITY_CASES = [
  ["P1", "P1", true],
  ["p1", "P1", true],
  [" P2 ", "P2", true],
  ["P2", "P1", false],
  ["High", "P1", false],
  ["", "P1", false],
  [null, "P1", false],
]
```
